answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 24429 Country: GH Title: I was in the dream and saw my wife outside my room standing with another strange man, and this man was giving her money, and later the same man send his junior sister to bring a bow full of food to my wife, in same dream i over heard him telling my wife he will take her out. please whats the meaning of the dream. Question: i was in the dream and saw my wife outside my room standing with another strange man, and this man was giving her money, and later the same man send his junior sister to bring a bow full of food to my wife, in same dream i over heard him telling my wife he will take her out. please whats the meaning of the dream. Answer ID: 24429 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1606/1189/H=1431) The meaning is that your heart seems tended towards worldly taste, fancy and glitter. It involves the loss of world and the akhirah (hereafter). This is the meaning. You should not develop any kind of misunderstanding towards your wife or any the strange person. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
